lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Ottawa has served Stellantis with a notice of default on its federal funding agreement after the automaker signed a deal to sell its Brampton, Ont. assembly plant to defence contractor Roshel, The Canadian Press reports.
Alberta man, 19, accused of luring underage B.C. girl he met on Roblox, CityNews Vancouver reports.
The U.S. stock market shook, but it largely absorbed big swings for Nvidia and oil prices and finished with relatively modest losses, The Associated Press reports.
U.S. envoys meet with Putin in Moscow on Ukraine talks, to see Zelenskyy in Dublin after, The Associated Press reports.
A widespread outage hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook on Thursday, with many users enco, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
